admissions_overview.summary: In Zimbabwe you apply directly to each university through its own online portal; there is no central application system. Universities select mainly on A Level results (points from your best subjects), and most degrees also need five O Level passes at grade C or better, including English Language and usually Mathematics. Many universities have two intakes a year, in February and August, and some offer special entry for applicants with diplomas.
admissions_overview.notes: Programme names come from university adverts and the ZIMCHE list of accredited programmes (March 2026). Entry requirements and intakes change every year, so check the university advert before you apply. Only a sample of programmes is listed.
